intro: I am interested in the remote PySpark/Data Engineer role with Randstad Digital for the healthcare analytics client. The position aligns with my background in Python, SQL, PySpark, ETL, high-volume data processing, data validation, statistical reporting, testing support, and production issue resolution.
body: At Citi, I built and supported Python, SQL, PySpark, and cloud-oriented ETL pipelines that ingested telemetry from more than 6,000 infrastructure endpoints and transformed raw operational data into curated reporting, analytics, and forecasting datasets. I also created validation checks, reconciliation workflows, SQL reporting structures, and production support documentation to improve trust and maintainability across data products.

Your role emphasizes ETL scripts, tools, queries, healthcare data management, data validation, statistical report generation, unit and integration testing, SQL performance tuning, Hadoop/Spark/Hive/Python, and large-volume data processing. My experience maps well through high-volume ETL delivery, SQL optimization, PySpark processing, validation workflows, reporting datasets, production troubleshooting, requirements analysis, and detailed design documentation.

I want to be direct about fit: my strongest domain background is regulated banking infrastructure telemetry rather than healthcare claims, and my Cloudera ecosystem exposure is stronger around Hadoop/Hive/Spark concepts than hands-on Impala, Hue, Oozie, Yarn, Sqoop, and Kafka production ownership. Where I would bring immediate value is Python/PySpark and SQL data engineering, ETL maintainability, high-volume processing, validation, testing discipline, and reliable issue resolution for internal and external customers.
conclusion: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my Python, SQL, PySpark, ETL, data validation, and production support background can support this healthcare analytics data engineering engagement.
